items.title_zh: 现状诊断图与资料缺口
items.professional_dimension: 规划、冬季运行与证据治理 / Planning and winter evidence
proposal_sections: 设计依据与资料清单
总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
风险、版权与合规说明
items.evidence_summary_zh: 本项 complete 仅表示诊断方法、证据缺口和下一步已完整作答，不表示现场诊断已经完成。W1 预注册30个候选观察点和干冷/降雪/融雪/夜间四次记录，五态底图区分现状、已批、在建、规划和本案；当前无现场测绘、冬季监测和完整状态台账。
items.evidence_summary_en: Complete means that the diagnostic method, evidence gaps and next action are fully answered, not that field diagnosis is complete. W1 preregisters 30 candidate points and four dry-cold/snow/melt/night records, and the five-state map separates existing, approved, under-construction, planned and proposed. Survey, winter monitoring and status registers are absent.

items.professional_dimension: 战略—总体—重点区统筹 / Multi-scale planning
proposal_sections: 三层范围工作框架
统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
重点区域详细设计
items.evidence_summary_zh: 43.6 km²层研究气候—产业—运营能力，11.4 km²层组织六张冬季作业图，三重点区分别验证材料/设备、冬阳/建筑和站口换乘；面积用公告口径，提交 polygon 仅为临时容器。
items.evidence_summary_en: The 43.6 km² scale studies climate–industry–operations capacity, the 11.4 km² scale organizes six winter-operation maps, and the three key areas test materials/equipment, winter sun/building and station interchange. Announcement areas are used while submission polygons remain provisional.

items.professional_dimension: 城市设计与冬季作业系统 / Urban design and winter operations
proposal_sections: 三层范围工作框架
总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
items.evidence_summary_zh: 总体结构以“一册六图、D0/D1/D2三工况、W1—W8八项冬作”替代通用轴核叙事；五条候选链、四回冻点、三测试区和三地标组成可检查的冬季空间系统。
items.evidence_summary_en: The overall structure is one atlas, six maps, D0/D1/D2 conditions and W1–W8 work packages rather than a generic axis/node diagram. Five candidate routes, four refreeze points, three test zones and three landmarks make the system reviewable.

items.professional_dimension: 用地分类与概念拓扑 / Land-use classification and topology
proposal_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵
items.evidence_summary_zh: 四个分类代码分区完成机器可读拓扑和面积复算，但均标注 conceptual_topology_carrier/not statutory；方案不因冬季主题重划法定用地，official controls 到位后整体替换。
items.evidence_summary_en: Four coded zones complete machine-readable topology and area checks, but all are conceptual/non-statutory carriers. The winter theme does not rezone statutory land, and official controls trigger wholesale replacement.

items.title_zh: 开发强度或待确认控规条件
items.title_en: Development intensity or unresolved statutory controls
items.professional_dimension: 控规与指标边界 / Regulatory controls and metrics
proposal_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵
风险、版权与合规说明
items.evidence_summary_zh: 本项 complete 仅表示证据边界和复算前提已完整作答，不表示开发强度已确定：建筑基底为概念包络面积，总建面、FAR、密度、道路面积/比例均保持 unknown，须 official controls 与测绘后计算。
items.evidence_summary_en: Complete means the evidence boundary and recalculation prerequisites are fully answered, not that development intensity is determined. Building footprint is a concept-envelope area; total floor area, FAR, density and road area/ratio remain unknown pending official controls and survey.

items.title_zh: 建筑高度、体量与风貌控制
items.professional_dimension: 建筑、微气候与风貌 / Architecture and microclimate
proposal_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
重点区域详细设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
items.evidence_summary_zh: 三包络分别承载维修/热恢复、门斗/共学和候车/干燥关系；正文逐区登记平面依赖、剖面尺寸域、缺资料与下一阶段交付。当前只有未标比例关系原型，没有真实 1:500/1:100—1:200 套合图，也不虚构高度。
items.evidence_summary_en: Three envelopes carry repair/thermal recovery, vestibule/learning and waiting/drying relationships. The narrative registers plan dependencies, section dimension domains, missing data and next deliverables for each area. Only unscaled relational prototypes exist; there are no true site-fitted 1:500/1:100–1:200 drawings or invented heights.

items.professional_dimension: 城市更新与建筑全生命周期 / Renewal and building life cycle
proposal_sections: 用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
重点区域详细设计
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
items.evidence_summary_zh: 本项 complete 表示留改拆调查表、决策次序和缺口已作答，不表示具体建筑已分类。“门厅先改、首层再用、院落先试、新建最后”提供次序，并加入冻融、渗漏、热损失、日照、风雪、防冻和维护工时字段；建筑普查前不作拆除结论。
items.evidence_summary_en: Complete means the retain/renovate/demolish survey fields, decision order and gaps are answered, not that individual buildings are classified. Vestibule first, ground-floor reuse next, courtyard test before new build defines the order and adds freeze-thaw, leakage, heat loss, sun, wind/snow, freeze protection and maintenance hours. No demolition conclusion precedes inventory.

items.title_zh: 道路、轨道、慢行与停车组织
items.title_en: Road, rail, active travel and parking organization
items.professional_dimension: 交通与冬季换乘 / Mobility and winter interchange
proposal_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
重点区域详细设计
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
items.evidence_summary_zh: 五条候选链先保证无障碍、学校、站口、公交和应急，再安排骑行、配送、停车与设备；大钟寺叠合风雪、入口带水、排水和疏散。道路面积与比例因仅有线状走廊保持 unknown。
items.evidence_summary_en: Five routes prioritize accessibility, schools, stations, buses and emergency access before cycling, delivery, parking and equipment. Dazhongsi overlays wind/snow, tracked-in water, drainage and egress. Road area/ratio remain unknown because routes are lines.

items.title_zh: 市政与新型基础设施策略
items.professional_dimension: 排水、设施防冻与有限 AI / Utilities and limited AI
proposal_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
items.evidence_summary_zh: 市政策略分离洁净雪、盐雪、雨水和清洗水并登记设施低温/断电/人工模式。V1—V3 评价卡逐项给出输入、人工/规则基线、建议输出、人工确认、误报/漏报/提前量/漂移/无效工单等指标及停止退出；当前无模型、数据集或结果。
items.evidence_summary_en: Utilities separate clean snow, salt snow, rainwater and washwater and register cold/outage/manual modes. V1–V3 cards specify inputs, human/rule baselines, advisory outputs, human confirmation, false-alert/miss/lead-time/drift/unnecessary-work metrics, and stop/exit actions. No model, dataset or result currently exists.

items.professional_dimension: 景观、生态、冬阳与融水 / Landscape and winter ecology
proposal_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
items.evidence_summary_zh: 四个蓝绿搜索区和 W3/W6/W7/W8 同时处理洁净/含盐雪、融水、回冻、植物根域、冬阳、风雪与文保；现有比例仅为提交几何复算，生态和排水性能待现场/工程验证。
items.evidence_summary_en: Four blue-green search areas and W3/W6/W7/W8 address clean/salt snow, meltwater, refreeze, roots, winter sun, wind/snow and heritage together. Current ratios are submission-geometry calculations, with ecological/drainage performance pending field and engineering review.

items.title_zh: 三大重点片区详细设计
items.title_en: Detailed design for the three key areas
items.professional_dimension: 重点区平面、剖面与运营 / Key-area plan, section and operations
proposal_sections: 重点区域详细设计
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
items.evidence_summary_zh: 众智园、AI 原点和大钟寺各有一套场地套合前平面/剖面原型，逐项登记关系顺序、尺寸域、缺资料与下一阶段 1:500 平面和 1:100—1:200 代表性剖面交付。complete 指原型响应完整；本包明确没有真实比例场地图或工程结论。
items.evidence_summary_en: Zhongzhiyuan, AI Origin and Dazhongsi each have a pre-site-fit plan/section prototype registering relationship order, dimension domains, missing data, and next-stage 1:500 plans plus representative 1:100–1:200 sections. Complete means the prototype response is complete; the package explicitly contains no true scaled site drawing or engineering conclusion.

items.professional_dimension: 项目化与责任接口 / Projects and responsibility interfaces
proposal_sections: 三层范围工作框架
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵
items.evidence_summary_zh: W1—W8 表格逐项给出0—6月、6—18月、永久工程前置和停止/回退；GeoJSON 对应八个项目载体。责任主体、预算、合同和审批均保持待确认，未虚构新机构。
items.evidence_summary_en: The W1–W8 table gives 0–6 month, 6–18 month, permanent-work prerequisites and stop/fallback actions, with eight corresponding GeoJSON carriers. Entities, budgets, contracts and approvals remain unresolved and no fictional institution is created.

items.professional_dimension: 实施、验证与回退 / Implementation and validation
proposal_sections: 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
风险、版权与合规说明
items.evidence_summary_zh: PHASE-001完成基线/共走/演练，PHASE-002只做可逆小样和一冬对照，PHASE-003在审批后实施并跨季复测；无雪演练不写成实绩，复制须经至少两个冷季。
items.evidence_summary_en: PHASE-001 establishes baseline/co-walk/exercise, PHASE-002 limits work to reversible prototypes and one-winter comparison, and PHASE-003 implements after approval with cross-season retesting. Snow-free exercises are not performance and replication follows at least two cold seasons.

items.professional_dimension: 几何、目标与 unknown 分类 / Geometry, targets and unknowns
proposal_sections: 用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵
风险、版权与合规说明
items.evidence_summary_zh: metrics.json 区分提交几何复算、proposal target/program 和 unknown 控制；FAR/密度/道路面积保持 unknown。26.58°与2小时分别是筛查量/目标；一个班次指各责任主体预登记的下一次有人值守交接窗口，记录触发及起止且不跨主体比较。
items.evidence_summary_en: metrics.json separates submission-geometry calculations, proposal targets/program counts and unknown controls; FAR/density/road area remain unknown. The 26.58° value versus 2 h are screening input versus target. One shift is each entity's preregistered next staffed handover window, with trigger/start/end recorded and no cross-entity comparison.

items.professional_dimension: 风险、合规与停止条件 / Risk and compliance
proposal_sections: 设计依据与资料清单
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵
风险、版权与合规说明
items.evidence_summary_zh: 31项 assumptions 覆盖边界、控规、测绘、五态、气象、跨季、太阳、风雪、责任、储雪、排水、无障碍、机器人、AI、文保、能耗、实施、目标、案例、同业、OSM、概念图及各概念图层/目标；每项都有影响和关闭触发器。
items.evidence_summary_en: Thirty-one assumptions cover boundaries, controls, survey, five states, weather, seasons, sun, wind/snow, responsibility, storage, drainage, accessibility, robots, AI, heritage, energy, implementation, targets, cases, peers, OSM, concept imagery, and conceptual layers/targets, each with impact and resolution trigger.
